summary: Berlin, software engineer, extensive experience in Java, Kotlin, and Rust, strong interest in DevOps and cloud infrastructure, advocates for basic income, critical of gig economy and automation's impact on jobs, prefers asynchronous communication over meetings, engaged in startup and freelance work, enjoys cooking and food preservation techniques, critical of corporate bureaucracy, values simplicity in software development, interested in renewable energy and environmental issues, skeptical of traditional media and journalism, prefers using open-source tools and technologies, advocates for user privacy and data protection, experienced in agile methodologies but critical of their implementation in corporate settings.
